summary: Modern dictionaries and offline contextual suggestions

changes.title: Modern English and Roman Hindi vocabulary
changes.detail: Adds reviewed modern terms, Indian English and Roman Hindi forms, with conservative prefix suggestions and spelling-valid entries. Existing stock English dictionaries and installed user dictionaries are retained.

changes.title: Offline contextual suggestions
changes.detail: A compact model improves eligible English, Indian English and Roman Hindi next-word and manual suggestions. It is enabled by default and can be switched off in Predictions & suggestions. Completed swipe keeps the native winner and can reorder alternatives.

changes.title: Safer apostrophe suggestions
changes.detail: Reviewed omissions such as dont and shouldnt can suggest their written contractions. Ambiguous real words such as were and well retain their literal forms on automatic commit, while contextual alternatives remain available for manual selection.
